# Coded Value Attribute Management UI PR Readiness Check

Ensure the following before merging:

1. **Functionality**
   - [ ] Verify attribute editing works end-to-end
   - [ ] Test boolean attribute dropdown integration
   - [ ] Confirm parent definition guidance displays correctly

2. **Architecture**
   - [ ] Ensure changes align with Blazor best practices
   - [ ] Verify structured logging implementation
   - [ ] Confirm cancellation tokens correctly implemented

3. **UX**
   - [ ] Check responsive design on different screen sizes
   - [ ] Verify accessibility labels are correctly implemented
   - [ ] Test all loading states and error handling

4. **Backward Compatibility**
   - [ ] Confirm changes don't break existing attribute flows
   - [ ] Ensure UI works with both text and boolean attributes
